test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following indicates 'Some hard workers are smart workers'?

options.text: No smart workers are hard workers.
Only some smart workers are not hard workers.
All smart workers are hard workers.
All hard workers are smart workers.

solution:
From the given statement, the Venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/63294cdd4c16f44d908ab02557f685adbf772f570bae3c3257f50f9d0af35c09.png] 

Now we consider each option:

1) No smart workers are hard workers:- It is not in accordance with the diagram.

2) Only some smart workers are not hard workers:- Since some hard workers are smart workers, some smart workers are surely not hard workers. Thus this statement is correct.

3) All smart workers are hard workers:- We can see that this will not be true in the given case.

4) All hard workers are smart workers:- We can see that this will not be true in the given case.

Hence **the correct answer is option 2).**
